name: Liberation DMX
description: Drive Liberation laser software through its DMX Input system over Art-Net. Up to 8 zones, each mapped to one Liberation DMX Input profile (Basic 16ch or Extended 32ch). Gobo Bank / Gobo Select are hidden behind Page + Clip dropdowns listed by Liberation's own clip numbers, or typed straight in as a Clip X / Clip Y pair; position is a normalized Point2D written to the 16-bit coarse/fine channel pairs.

Zone Count.description: How many Liberation zones to control. Each zone gets its own channel block and its own DMX Input profile row in Liberation. Lowering this blanks the removed zones' channels first, so a zone that was armed is disarmed rather than left streaming.

New Zone Profile.description: Profile given to zones as they are created. Each zone's own Profile parameter can be changed afterwards.

Auto Address.description: Stack zones automatically from Base Universe / Base Address, using each zone's profile size (16 or 32 channels). Turn off to set Universe and Start Address per zone by hand.

Base Universe.description: Universe of the first zone, in Liberation's 1-based UI numbering. Universe 1 = Art-Net Port-Address 0. Only used when Auto Address is on.

Base Address.description: Start channel of the first zone (1-512). Only used when Auto Address is on.

Rebuild Zones.description: Recreate the zone tree and re-send every zone. Use after editing addresses by hand, or if the tree ever looks out of sync.

Log Addressing.description: Print each zone's universe, channel range and profile to the log, so it can be copied into Liberation's DMX Input window.

Arm Follows Clip.description: Selecting a clip arms that zone automatically, and selecting 'None' disarms it, so a trigger or mapping only has to set the clip. SAFETY: with this on, choosing a clip immediately enables laser output for the zone. Turn it off to drive the Arm channel yourself.

Intensity Follows Clip.description: Selecting a clip also sets that zone's Intensity to full (255), so a clip never lands on a zone that was left dimmed.

Master Intensity.description: Grand master: scales every zone's Intensity on the way out to DMX. Does not change the per-zone Intensity values, so pulling it down and back up restores the look.

On.description: Arm channel: on sends 255 (output enabled), off sends 0.
A disabled zone keeps streaming but forces its Arm channel to 0, so Liberation stops rendering it.

Zone.description: Zone to black out. 0 = all zones. Sets Arm off; the rest of the zone's state is left untouched.
Zone to reset to Liberation's recommended defaults (Arm off, intensity 1, white, centred, no clip). 0 = all zones.

Value.description: Grand master applied to every zone's Intensity on the way out.

Page.description: Clip deck page. Sent on the Gobo Bank channel. Page N covers deck columns (N-1)*8 to (N-1)*8+7.

Clip.description: Slot on the selected page, in the deck's own fill order (down a column, then across). Sent on the Gobo Select channel. Column here is 1-8 within the page - to work in Liberation's own clip numbers instead, use Select Clip Number.

X.description: First figure of Liberation's clip number: deck column counted across every page, 0 = leftmost. Right-click a clip in Liberation and its settings header prints the pair. -1 = no clip.

Y.description: Second figure of Liberation's clip number: deck row, 0 = top. -1 = no clip.

Page.description: Clip deck page (Gobo Bank). The zone keeps its current slot. Page N covers deck columns (N-1)*8 to (N-1)*8+7.

Clip.description: Slot on the zone's current page. Column here is 1-8 within the page - to work in Liberation's own clip numbers instead, use Select Clip Number. 'None' sends Gobo Select 0 = no clip / blackout.

Zone.description: Zone to clear (Gobo Select 0 = no clip). 0 = all zones.

Colour.description: Desk RGB. Alpha is ignored - use Intensity for brightness.

Value.description: 0 = clip's own colour, 1 = desk RGB colour.

Position.description: -1..1 on both axes, (0,0) = centre. +X right, +Y DOWN (Liberation's own convention). Written to the 16-bit coarse/fine channel pairs.

Value.description: -1 = full up, 0 = centre, 1 = full down (+Y is down). 16-bit.

Scale.description: Size on each axis: 1 = 100%, the clip as authored (DMX 255). 0 = 0%, nothing renders (DMX 128). -1 = 100% mirrored on that axis (DMX 0).

Value.description: 1 = 100%, the clip as authored. 0 = 0%, nothing renders. -1 = 100% mirrored on this axis.
1 = 100%, the clip as authored. 0 = 0%, nothing renders. -1 = 100% mirrored on this axis.
Spin speed: -1 = max counter-clockwise, 0 = stopped, 1 = max clockwise.

Zone.description: Zone to target. 0 = all zones. Extended 32ch profile only.
Zone to target. 0 = all zones. Extended 32ch profile only.

Parameter.description: Which of the effect's first two exposed parameters to set.

Value.description: 0-1 mapped to 0-255. 0.5 is the recommended neutral value (DMX 128).

Zone.description: Zone whose four FX levels go to 0 (parameters are left as they are). 0 = all zones.
Zone to target. 0 = all zones. Extended 32ch profile only.

BPM.description: Tempo for this zone's DMX-rendered content. Sent as coarse BPM + 1/256 fine.

Zone.description: Zone that goes back to following Liberation's own tempo. 0 = all zones.
